title: Television: John Lennon and Yoko Ono on Kup’s Show | 1972
content:
John Lennon and Yoko Ono were interviewed for the television programme Kup’s Show on 11 May 1972.

Kup’s Show was presented by Chicago Sun-Times columnist Irv Kupcinet. The interview was filmed at the WMAQ-TV studios in the Merchandise Mart building in Chicago, and was broadcast at 11pm on 13 May.
